reason: E1 directly supports oxide film rupture during wear and galvanic corrosion between FCC and σ phases, but it does not demonstrate the proposed synergistic feedback loop or accelerated degradation under simultaneous wear and corrosion at elevated temperature. E2 confirms multiphase structures induce galvanic corrosion and inferior corrosion resistance, but again lacks evidence for the coupled wear-corrosion synergy. The key premise of a positive feedback loop accelerating degradation is not supported by the cited evidence.
premises: Mechanical wear ruptures protective oxide films on HEAs at elevated temperature
Multiphase eutectic HEAs contain phases (FCC and σ) with a potential difference
Exposed phase boundaries form galvanic cells that intensify local corrosion
Corrosion undermines structural integrity, making the alloy more susceptible to further wear
This synergistic feedback loop accelerates overall degradation relative to a single-phase HEA
